title: Ministry Finalises Three Short Films to Strengthen Awareness against Substance Abuse
subtitle:
Videos Focus on Early Warning Signs, National De-addiction Helpline 14446 and the Role of Parents and Teachers
Initiative Supports the Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan’s Goal of Promoting a Drug-Free Society
body_text:
The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE), with its department being a nodal agency for Drug Demand Reduction in the country, has finalised three short films of 60 seconds each to create widespread public awareness about substance abuse and its harmful effects.
The Department Of Social Justice and Empowerment has been implementing the National Action Plan for Drug Demand Reduction (NAPDDR) with the objective of creating awareness and educating the general public about the ill effects of substance abuse.
Under the Scheme, the Department launched the Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan (NMBA) on 15th August 2020. The flagship campaign is aimed at creating awareness about the ill effects of substance abuse and promoting a drug-free society.
With the objective of strengthening public awareness, the Ministry has finalised the three short films on the following themes:
1.  Understanding early warning signs and behavioural changes associated with substance use, including peer pressure;
2.  National De-addiction and Tele-counselling Helpline—14446; and
3.  Role of parents and teachers in the early identification, prevention and treatment of substance use.
The films are intended to strengthen awareness, encourage timely intervention and promote collective action by families, educational institutions and communities against substance abuse.

enrichment.summary: The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment has finalised three 60-second short films to raise public awareness about substance abuse, covering early warning signs, the National De-addiction Helpline (14446), and the role of parents and teachers. These films support the Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan (NMBA), launched on 15 August 2020 under the National Action Plan for Drug Demand Reduction (NAPDDR).
enrichment.context: The Department of Social Justice and Empowerment is the nodal agency for Drug Demand Reduction in India and implements NAPDDR, which funds awareness generation, treatment facilities, counselling, and capacity building to combat substance abuse. NMBA was launched as a flagship campaign to create a drug-free society, initially targeting vulnerable districts and later expanded nationwide, involving outreach through educational institutions, workplaces, and community programmes along with the toll-free helpline 14446 for tele-counselling and referral services. This release is a routine communication activity under an existing scheme rather than a new policy initiative or scheme expansion.
